# TDEV

> Sustainable fashion rooted in nature, refined by design. Explore the Global, Femme, and Homme collections.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand overview and featured collections.
- [Shop](/shop): Browse all collections (Femme, Homme, Global).
- [Femme Collection](/category/femme): Womenswear — Spring 2026.
- [Homme Collection](/category/homme): Refined menswear.
- [Global Collection](/category/global): Raw materials and global influences.
- [Journal](/blog): Stories, style notes, and brand updates.
- [Customize](/customize): Design your own custom shirt.
- [Games](/games): Play to win discount codes.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with our team.

## Optional

- [Wishlist](/wishlist): Saved items (per-user, local).
